en.title: Rate Limit by Multiple Request Fields
en.description:
Each request has several field dimensions, and each dimension is configured with its own fieldName, window, and limit. A request is ALLOW only if no dimension exceeds its limit; this site explicitly uses the sliding window [timestamp-window,timestamp), and only ALLOW requests are counted in each dimension's history, so requests that get REJECT do not consume quota.

The parts marked 'added by this site' and the standard input/output protocol were explicitly compiled by this site; they do not mean the original problem has other unstated rules.
en.input: The first line contains d q; then d lines of fieldName window limit; then q lines of timestamp value1 ... valued. Added by this site: 1≤d≤10, 1≤q≤200000, window and limit are positive integers, values contain no spaces, and timestamps are non-decreasing.
en.output: For each request, output ALLOW or REJECT, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: First separate each rule of the original problem from the input conventions added by this site, then choose a suitable data structure.
